title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-06
content:
2025-02-20 - daily scratchpad (GPU ops)
Owner: Ethan Chen
Quick context: personal working notes for infra tasks: capacity checks, node health, networking follow-ups, and follow-ups from last oncall. Mostly reminders and commands to run; not polished.

TODAY'S PRIORITIES
- Validate capacity for Dedicated cluster A (eu-west) before 09:30 PST: need to confirm we can accept +20% burst for PR-824 without violating SLOs.
- Investigate recurring OOMs on rk-gpu-node-23 (tensorflow jobs) reproduce, collect logs, attach to JIRA.
- Finish small-netting change rollback plan after last night's flapping (coord with SRE Priya).
- Prep notes for infra sync: GPU driver upgrade timeline + canary pool selection.

CHECKLIST / RUNBOOK REMINDERS
- Check cluster metrics:
  - grafana: infra/gpu-cluster -> mem_pressure, gpu_util, pod_evictions
  - run: kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr (watch for >90% memory)
- Node health quick commands:
  - kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "gpu|rk"
  - ssh core@rk-gpu-node-23 sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 500 --no-pager | grep -i oom
  - nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY | grep -A5 "FB Memory Usage"
- If OOM observed, scale down suspicious jobs (ml-training-prod) and cordon node: kubectl cordon rk-gpu-node-23; kubectl drain rk-gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data

NOTES / INVESTIGATION (rk-gpu-node-23)
- Symptoms: intermittent pod evictions (~03:00-05:00 UTC) over last 3 nights. Affected jobs: tf-train-ml-large v2 containers. Logs show CUDA OOM in runtime (not k8s OOM).
- Hypothesis: checkpointing spike + insufficient swap? Need to verify process-level memory growth.
- Actions taken: captured pmap and process tree (PID 2411), saved to /tmp/ethan/rk23-oom-20250220.tar.gz ; attached to JIRA-PLAT-298.
- Next: add ephemerally larger memory limit to job for one run and monitor; if passes, update GPU profiles.

CAPACITY NOTES (eu-west - Dedicated cluster A)
- Current committed capacity: 120 GPUs reserved (p4d / a100 mix).
- Observed 7-day peak: 98 GPUs used (90% of committed). 20% burst + headroom target = 120 * 0.2 = 24 GPUs -> need spare capacity ~122 total.
- Action: run quick scheduler simulation (local script: infra/tools/simulate-burst.py --cluster eu-west --delta 24) before noon. If results show >95% latency SLO breach, coordinate short-term burst with cloud provider quota.

NETWORKING FOLLOW-UPS
- Last night saw flapping on BGP peer to partner-net-2 during driver rollout window. Symptoms: short dropouts causing kube-proxy reconvergence.
- Plan: rollback recent net change (PR: github.com/redwood/netops/pull/371) to previous config, then re-apply with 5m drain windows. Priya to confirm rollback time.
- TODO: add synthetic probe (tcp/443) from eu-west-lb to partner-net-2 to detect early. Add to prometheus job: probe_partner_net2_eu_west (endpoint /probe).

UPGRADES / ROLLOUTS
- GPU driver 535.x upgrade schedule: canary pool = rk-canary-{01..03} (3 nodes) in us-west.
- Need to confirm CUDA compat matrix for a100+p4d combos (ask research: Miguel).
- Post-upgrade checks: run our perf-bench script (infra/bench/gpu_perf_bench.sh) and validate token/sec within 5% baseline.

BLOCKERS / QUESTIONS
- Priya: did the netops team capture the BGP logs for 2025-02-19 22:00-23:00 UTC? I want zgrep results before rolling back.
- Platform quota request for +24 GPUs: escalate to cloud-sales if provider quota growth >72h. Who owns sales contact? (Liam?)
- Is there a short-term temporary migration plan for tf-train-ml-large to move to Dedicated cluster B (us-west) if eu-west stays unstable? Cost OK for emergency.

MEETING NOTES (infra sync 2025-02-20)
- Topics: canary rollout schedule, ongoing OOMs, cost vs burst tradeoff. Agreed: try simulated burst before provisioning additional capacity.
- Action items assigned:
  - Ethan: run simulate-burst, attach artifact to JIRA-PLAT-298 (due EOD).
  - Priya: get BGP logs and confirm rollback window (due 10:00 PST).
  - Liam: check quota pipeline and reach out to provider contact (due 12:00 PST).

MISC NOTES / TODO (quick)
- Add a check in deploy pipeline to verify ephemeral FS free space before training starts (last incident caused disk-full -> checkpoint fail).
- Add troubleshooting snippet to runbook: how to extract dmesg OOM kill details for container PID mapping.
- Follow up on PR #824 (scheduler improvements) — need re-review performance tests.

RAW COMMANDS I RAN (for my reference)
- kubectl get pods -n ml-prod -o wide | grep Evicted > /tmp/ethan/evicted-20250220.txt
- ssh core@rk-gpu-node-23 sudo tar czf /tmp/rk23-oom-logs.tgz /var/log/kern.log /var/log/docker.log /var/lib/docker/containers/*/json.log
- python infra/tools/simulate-burst.py --cluster eu-west --delta 24 --output /tmp/sim-eu-west-24.json

ATTACHMENTS / LINKS
- JIRA-PLAT-298 (OOM on rk-gpu-node-23)
- JIRA-INC-4121 (last night's networking incident)
- Confluence: internal/gpu-capacity-plan (notes + historicals)

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep this doc short-lived; once tasks done, fold into confluence incident note and archive.
- If I go oncall tomorrow, leave sticky note in #sre-tty channel with quick runbook link.

---
End of scratchpad entry
